name: Work board orphan sweeper (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: every 10 min (launchd com.powos.board-sweep, tools/agents/board-sweep.sh from the $POWOS_RUN_ROOT/verify-runner checkout, default ~/pw/verify-runner): syncs the verify queue's jobs and results into the board's work_check rows and runs `powos agents sweep` on the phone, which mails the coordinator ONE digest of new or changed orphan tasks (stalled, no-check, FAILs nobody picked up), user asks with no task and new friction. One adb call per pass, then it exits
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one short bash + python pass (a git fetch, a queue scan, one adb call capped at 180 s) every 10 minutes, niced
